content:
Apple today welcomed a new CEO. At the same time, a precious 1996 video of Steve Jobs has resurfaced, offering some incredible perspectives.

The interview comes from Maryland Public Television's Wall Street Week with Louis Rukeyser.

The interview took place before Jobs returned to Apple. In it, he made a remarkable statement about his belief that Apple could emerge from its troubles through innovation.

"I don't think the way out is to massively cut costs. I think the way out is to innovate. That's how Apple came back to life before, and I think that's how Apple will return to its glory."

Thirty years later, the results proved him right (for Apple, for Pixar, and for Toy Story).
